confirmedFindings.title: Non-Atomic UDP Port Reservation Causes EADDRINUSE
confirmedFindings.body: Returning an available port number without immediately marking it as allocated in the allocatedPorts set creates a race condition where multiple concurrent call setups receive the same port, causing OS bind collisions with EADDRINUSE.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Atomically mark the port as allocated before returning it.
